deep.reconstruction:
This page has no mathematics. It is the inside front cover or flyleaf of the bound volume (Handbuch 7) and carries only library and conservation marks:
(a) An old shelf or inventory number, 'N. 288', in blue pencil at the upper left. It matches the 'N.288' on the next page.
(b) A pencilled modern library signature: 'Cod MS Gauß' with a struck-through 'Nr. 21', then 'Handb 7', then a foliation note '159 Bl.' dated 5.3.76 (5 March 1976) with a librarian's initials.
(c) A printed book-sponsorship (Buchpatenschaft) label of the SUB Göttingen. It records restoration funded by Dr. Ruthild Winkler-Oswatitsch.
(d) Several red sealing-wax or adhesive residues along the edges and near the top and bottom centre.
None of this is by Gauss. The mathematical content of the bundle begins on the next page, which states Lagrange's inversion series for x = t + u·ψ(x). That series is outside the scope of this page.
deep.surprise_reason: The page holds only archival shelf marks, a foliation note and a modern restoration sponsorship label. There is no mathematical content by Gauss.
transcription_corrections: Transcription is essentially correct. 'Nr. 21' is struck through in pencil, as indicated.
The final pencilled item reads '159 Bl. 5.3.76' followed by a librarian's initials or paraph. These are illegible and probably not a word. It is a 1976 foliation count of 159 leaves.
Unrecorded non-text features: red sealing-wax or adhesive residues at the left edge (three spots) and at top and bottom centre.
